study type: Observational cross-sectional study with repeated measures
outcome: Physiological autonomic response (Analgesia Nociception Index - ANI)
cohort: The study included 221 patients aged 22 to 82 years undergoing either diagnostic (n=125) or operative (n=96) hysteroscopy.
finding: Subjective pain assessment using the VAS did not statistically significantly correlate with objective ANI values, indicating a dissociation between self-reported pain and physiological autonomic response during hysteroscopy under local anesthesia.
cross-section timing: Measurements were conducted immediately before the procedure (T0), at the 1st minute (T1), mid-procedure (T1/2), and at the end of the procedure (T2).
